## Purpose

Describe the problem, root cause and user-visible effect.

## Validation

List the exact tests, builds and device checks that were run. State what was not tested.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [development rules](../docs/policies/DevelopmentRules.md).
- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass and `git diff --check` is clean.
- [ ] Performance claims include repeatable A/B evidence at identical quality.
- [ ] Device-specific behavior is optional and generic Android ARM64 remains supported.
- [ ] No games, keys, firmware, saves, caches, secrets, signing material or private paths are included.
- [ ] Documentation and attribution are updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] Substantial AI-assisted or generated work is disclosed below.

## Generated-work disclosure

State the tools used and the human verification performed, or write `None`.
